additional_info.subject: ID0470524-DC/Si-D/DE- [RVP/S3170003393] Charging Issue CRM:03056000888
additional_info.body:
Dear Hanno,
Thank you for contacting our eMobility Support.
After reviewing the issue and the information provided, we can confirm that the charger is providing a maximum of 120 kW due to the vehicle's request.
As shown in the attached logs, the charger is capable of delivering up to 400 kW:
However, the car is requesting and supporting only a 120 kW charging session.
Please do not hesitate to contact us if you need further assistance.
Best regards,
Ivan
Siemens eMobility Technical Support Team

additional_info.subject: AW: ID0470524-DC/Si-D/DE- [RVP/S3170003393] Charging Issue CRM:03056000888
additional_info.body:
Hello Ivan, the trucks in question are Actros E 600, which can charge at up to 400 kW. This charging power was previously also provided by the stations. However, the charging process was already aborted with an error message — what exactly was the issue there? The charging stations also do not yet have a connection to Chargesight. How can the IP addresses be viewed and/or configured directly at the charging station?
Mit freundlichen Grüßen
kind regards
Hanno Aden

additional_info.body:
Dear Hanno,
Thank you for contacting our eMobility Support.
As shown in the logs attached to our previous email, we found no errors on the charging station side. The charger is capable of delivering up to 400 kW, but the vehicle is requesting only 120 kW.
We checked the timestamp provided in your e-form (06/01/26 at 9.20) but found no anomalies at that specific time.
Since you mentioned an error message, could you please provide a more specific timestamp? This will allow us to perform a more detailed investigation.
Best regards,
Ivan
Siemens eMobility Technical Support Team
